scripts.test: bun run --filter @farfield/protocol build && bun run --workspaces test
scripts.test:ci:mocked: bun run --cwd packages/CodexProtocol build && bun run --cwd apps/ServerApplication test -- Tests/AgentRuntimeOwner.test.ts Tests/ThreadAdapterResolver.test.ts Tests/ThreadMemberReadRouteOwner.test.ts Tests/ThreadMemberRoutes.integration.test.ts Tests/ServerObservabilitySnapshotOwner.test.ts && bun run --cwd apps/WebApplication test -- Tests/ApplicationRuntimeComposition.test.tsx Tests/AppSessionAndDebug.test.tsx Tests/AppShellBehavior.test.tsx Tests/AppThreadRefreshBehavior.test.tsx
scripts.coverage:check: bun run --filter @farfield/protocol build && bun run --workspaces test:coverage
scripts.lint: bunx eslint apps/ServerApplication/Source apps/ServerApplication/Tests apps/WebApplication/Source apps/WebApplication/Tests apps/WebApplication/vite.config.ts packages/CodexProtocol/Source packages/CodexProtocol/Tests packages/CodexInterfaceAdapter/Source packages/CodexInterfaceAdapter/Tests packages/OpenCodeInterfaceAdapter/Source packages/OpenCodeInterfaceAdapter/Tests --max-warnings=0
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/CodexProtocol build && bun run --cwd packages/CodexInterfaceAdapter build && bun run --cwd packages/OpenCodeInterfaceAdapter build && bun run --cwd apps/ServerApplication typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/WebApplication typecheck
scripts.premerge:check: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run coverage:check
scripts.end-to-end:real:run: node scripts/with-env.mjs "bun run --filter @farfield/protocol build && bunx playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts"
scripts.end-to-end:real:ui: node scripts/with-env.mjs "bun run --filter @farfield/protocol build && bunx playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts --ui"
scripts.end-to-end:real:debug: node scripts/with-env.mjs "bun run --filter @farfield/protocol build && bunx playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts --debug"
scripts.verify:end-to-end:real: bun run smoke:app && bun run end-to-end:real:safe-run
